pairs.question: His largiri non est via largitatis; quare?
pairs.answer: Quia dare leccatoribus ut a sanctis perhibetur, idem erit ac si detur victima daemonibus.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-answered question. The setup 'His largiri non est via largitatis' is kept verbatim so 'quare?' has a referent (why giving to these is not the way of generosity). The answer is the contiguous 'Quia...daemonibus', which runs to the end of the stanza/sentence and directly answers the 'why'. Stanza-number 'XX' scaffolding and stanza boundaries stripped; no editorial brackets present.
